$comment: Declared values transcribed from a community source record, not a physical measurement. As a documented_specification this record has no instruments and no readings, so it cannot feed parts/993-int-switch-blank-0001/source/switch_blank.py or twins/993-cabin-dashboard-switch-0001/source/check_fit.py, which build only from readings. pdf_page is null and plate carries the locator in the source (the thread number), because the validator requires one of the two. The MNL- prefix of value_id is the validator's pattern for every declared value, whatever the source type. Desk test of docs/CAPTURE_PROTOCOL.md on pilot 1, decision 0013.

subject.part_reference: not established; candidate 993 613 523 00 unconfirmed, see the part record
subject.description: Opening sizes declared by an owner who measured a window switch to estimate the opening of a warning lamp above the ignition lock; no instrument, datum or repeat stated.

session.operator_role: maintainer, desk review of existing sources

datum.origin: None declared: the source states no origin, reference face or measuring point
datum.axes: Not applicable: width x height of a rectangular opening as declared; orientation on the car not recorded in the source record

declared_values.description: Passage under the covering, width x height, as declared
declared_values.plate: Rennlist thread 1202129; post not re-read, the page is blocked to automated reading

details.feature: passage under the covering, measured on a window switch
details.interpretation: Not the minimum opening H01/H02 of TWIN-993-CABIN-DASH-SWITCH-0001: the source gives this figure for the passage under the covering, behind the faceplate. It is the figure the concept F0 and the fit-test kit use as the opening.
details.source_record_wording: environ 19 x 31 mm pour le passage sous le revetement (about 19 x 31 mm for the passage under the covering)

declared_values.description: Faceplate opening of a switch housing, width x height, as declared
declared_values.plate: Rennlist thread 1202129; post not re-read, the page is blocked to automated reading

details.feature: faceplate opening of an old switch housing
details.interpretation: Read as the host opening of TWIN-993-CABIN-DASH-SWITCH-0001 (H01 width, H02 height). This mapping is the repository's reading, not a statement of the source.
details.source_record_wording: ou environ 17 x 28 mm pour l'ouverture de la facade d'un ancien boitier d'interrupteur (or about 17 x 28 mm for the faceplate opening of an old switch housing)

contradictions: The concept F0 and the fit-test kit take 19 x 31 mm as the opening, while this source gives that figure for the passage under the covering and about 17 x 28 mm for the faceplate opening. SRC-RENNLIST-993-CONSOLE-SWITCH-HOLE-DIMENSIONS gives 17.0 x 27.9 mm for the console opening and 16.2 x 27.4 mm for the blank. The two figures of this source differ by 2 mm in width and 3 mm in height; the fit-test kit brackets only the larger one, by plus or minus 0.4 mm.

Location: the values come from a window switch measured to estimate a lamp opening above the ignition lock; the part record names a dashboard switch-blank location. Whether they describe the same opening is not established.

notes: Desk transcription under the owner's no-buy, no-measure constraint (2026-09-14). These are declared values: they stay out of readings, do not change geometry.source_type, and cannot open the measured-input gate of the switch blank master. Both figures of the source are kept separately; neither is preferred, averaged or adjusted. Re-read the thread when it becomes accessible and set checked_against_original_post accordingly.
